lines.text: Chamber safe. Now we open it.

lines.speaker: N. (stored recording)
lines.text: If you are hearing this, Alo bloomed. Good. Now Alo needs a friend.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Another plant was in the next room all along.

lines.speaker: Amara
lines.text: And it has a name. Tara.
